items.title: Moving out
materials: Iman plans to move in four weeks. Compare the fictional options, protect essentials, and prepare the first week of independent living.

| Item | Option A | Option B |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Rent | 600/month | 700/month |
| Utilities estimate | 140/month | 100/month |
| Transport | 120/month | 40/month |
| Stated upfront costs | 600 rent + 600 deposit + 150 moving | 700 rent + 700 deposit + 100 moving |
| Journey | Last bus 20:15; occasional work ends 21:00 | Step-free route not yet verified |
| Terms | Repairs clause incomplete | Cancellation/notice wording incomplete |

Take-home income: 1,500/month. Other essentials: food 220, phone 25, debt payment 80. Available move fund: 1,550, separate from the recurring budget. New home's emergency/access plan is unknown. Contract and deposit amounts are fictional and do not establish legal requirements.

items.title: Busy week
materials: Em is managing work/study, an appointment, a bill, and household tasks. The week should remain feasible when something changes.

| Commitment | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Monday work | 09:00–16:00 |
| Monday appointment | 16:15; travel 35 minutes |
| Tuesday assignment | Due 12:00; 90 minutes of work left |
| Monday evening | 120 minutes free, including food and rest |
| Bill | Due Tuesday; amount already reserved; payment request must be verified |
| Laundry | 30 minutes of active work; can wait until Wednesday |
| Transport | Usual return service may be cancelled; alternative needs verification |
| Support | A trusted person could discuss task sharing, but has not agreed |
items.task:
Create a realistic dated plan and identify what cannot fit. Draft an appointment/commitment message and a task-sharing request. Verify bill and journey routes, plan basic food/rest, and schedule a later skills reassessment. Explain what you will defer and why.

Session 1: analyse and verify. Session 2: produce calculations, messages, and plan. Session 3: review your reasoning and handle the variation. Record any prompts or help; close the explanation for an independent attempt.
Also address the changed situation: The appointment cannot be moved and the assignment takes another hour. Replan, communicate early, and identify the unresolved constraint instead of claiming everything fits.
For each assessed skill below, produce its full output. Where information is missing, state the gap and a verified next step. Include a minimal fictional record, access limits, a follow-up/reminder, and no personal details.
